mode.title: Mode
mode.description: pack: one Wikipedia pack for one base and language. menu: the base and all its packs -> the search packs, every language version merged and checked, and the recipes

base_url.title: Base ZIM URL
base_url.description: The region's multilingual base ZIM (streetzim --multilingual), the very file the packs and recipes are for. A URL; on the command line also a local file, read where it is

region.title: Region id
region.description: Region id the parts are named after (osm_<region>_wiki-<xx>). Default: from the packs' names, else the base's Name (osm_mul_monaco: monaco); it must agree with both

jobs.title: Processes
jobs.description: Processes: articles read and cleaned at a time (pack), search packs built at a time (menu). Default: 4

language.title: Wikipedia language
language.description: Pack: the Wikipedia language, as Kiwix names its Wikipedia ZIMs (de, fr, ja, ...)

wikipedia_zim_url.title: Wikipedia ZIM URL
wikipedia_zim_url.description: Pack: that language's Kiwix Wikipedia ZIM (a full one: every article of the region is looked up in it). Default: the newest wikipedia_<xx>_all_maxi in Kiwix's catalog (library.kiwix.org), else on download.kiwix.org. A URL (download.kiwix.org or a mirror, a path with /zim/, no query) is checked against the SHA-256 in the .meta4 of the same path on download.kiwix.org, and fails without one; on the command line also a local file, read where it is

images.title: Wikipedia images
images.description: Pack: pictures per article: none, the lead one (default, as StreetZim's own packs), or all (up to 12)

no_wikidata_text.title: No Wikidata text
no_wikidata_text.description: Pack: leave out the place names and descriptions in the language from Wikidata (wikidata-text.json)

pack_url.title: Pack URLs
pack_url.description: Menu: a Wikipedia pack of this base (from --mode pack, named osm_<region>_wiki-<xx>_...zim); one per language, repeated. Each is gated again before use

languages.title: Menu languages
languages.description: Menu: the map languages to offer, comma-separated. Default: StreetZim's core set (the 21 label languages and English). The base's region languages are always offered; a language is offered only with its pack (or in the base)

url_template.title: Part URL template
url_template.description: Menu: each part's URL in the recipes, {file} its file name (https://download.kiwix.org/zim/maps/{file}). Default: {file}, relative to wherever the recipes are published

stats_filename.title: Stats filename
stats_filename.description: Path to store the progress JSON file to
